concept.note: Pixels of the accepted Azure candidate, re-encoded without metadata.

limitations: Single-view TRELLIS reconstruction from one approved concept: the far side, back and underside are TRELLIS's invention.
Roughness and metalness come from colour classes and Cycles bakes, not measured PBR.
Clips are procedural oscillators on a small rig (body, head, tail; arms and hands of each wing), not motion capture.

TRELLIS fused the perched crow's folded wings into its body and the flying crow's feathers into flat sheets; the view swaps the perched and flying models at take-off and landing instead of folding the wings.
Feathers are a baked TRELLIS texture at 256 px; no separate feather cards.
TRELLIS-derived: research and evaluation licence terms, no commercial clearance.

cook.scriptsNote: SHA-256 of each script with LF line endings, equal to its committed copy.

normalization.axes: glTF +Y up/+Z forward -> Blender import -> glTF export_yup; no extra axis rotation

materials.provenance: Base colour re-baked (Cycles CPU, emission, selected-to-active) from the approved TRELLIS source mesh; there is no rear-view projection, so the far side and underside are as TRELLIS invented them from the single approved concept. Tangent normals baked from the source geometry and whiteout-blended with colour relief; AO baked from the decimated geometry; roughness lower on the darkest texels (beak and legs) and otherwise the glossy-feather default, both reduced by colour detail; no metal and no dye mask. Base colour lifted by luma power toneGamma (chroma ratios kept), set by eye in review renders. Artistic derivation, not measured PBR.

reorder.method: meshoptimizer reorderMesh: vertex-cache triangle order, then vertex-fetch vertex order
reorder.check: a permutation: every vertex keeps its exact attribute bytes, and the triangles are the same, with the same winding, in another order

geometryCompression.check: every view decoded again: attribute views byte-identical to the reordered data; triangle index views hold the same triangles in the same order and winding (only the first vertex may rotate)

settings.POSITION: SHORT normalized; uniform scale and offset folded into the inverse bind matrices

baseEncoding.reason: Base-colour alpha is the dye mask; libwebp's default lossy mode discards RGB under alpha 0.
